# Lion Dance Singapore

> > Your complete guide to lion dance traditions, Chinese New Year celebrations, and cultural performances in Singapore.

Lion Dance Singapore is the authoritative resource for understanding lion dance culture, booking professional troupes, and celebrating Chinese New Year in Singapore. The site covers everything from traditional symbolism and rituals to practical guides for event planning and cultural etiquette.

## Key Topics

- Lion Dance Traditions
- Chinese New Year (CNY)
- Singapore Cultural Events
- Cai Qing (Plucking the Greens)
- Eye-Dotting Ceremony (Hòu Yǎn)
- Lion Dance Troupes
- Cultural Symbolism
- Prosperity Blessings
- Event Planning & Booking
- Chinatown Markets
- Ang Bao Etiquette
- Dragon Dance vs Lion Dance
- CNY Decorations

- Chinese Cultural Performance
